node.title: BAND CHILD 1 (K3 ARM): the enumerated structural-supply cap at the deployed rows — the positive-433 workboard completes in distinct affine slopes
node.statement: DECOMPOSITION CHILD 1 of rate_half_band_closure (2026-08-09, user-directed; plan notes/band_decomposition_plan_20260809.md). CLAIM: the kb_m2_r4 positive-433 workboard enumeration COMPLETES — every cell and role orbit of the 433-1b board is closed (state at creation: c112 coverage + cells 3, 4, 9, 12-13 CLOSED; cell 5 in flight at 24 labels / 6 orbits; role orbits [5,8], [9,10] second half, [11] open), the label census is CONVERTED to upstream item K3's unit of account (distinct affine slopes, per przchojecki agents.md K3: exhaustive balanced-core coverage, genuine-pencil proof obligations, exact line counts), and the resulting enumerated supply cap at the deployed rows passes the independent proof review that the export certificates themselves require. This is the STRUCTURAL-SURPLUS arm: it establishes by enumeration that no unaccounted supply exists at the workboard rows. SCOPE: the workboard rows are n = 2^21 extension rows; transport to the n = 2^41 prime razor rows is NOTE-LEVEL (the WP5 quantifier mismatch stands) — this child feeds the parent as the enumerated arm, not as razor-row coverage. INHERITED FALSIFIER (the surplus direction of the parent's retired v2 falsifier, re-scoped): any deployed-row supply object outside the workboard's enumerated classes, or any workboard cell whose exclusion fails independent replay. Evidence at creation: the living export PR #1152 (cells 3/4/9/12-13 certified, whole-cell convention, per-node verifier sha256); 54/54 wave-54 verifier replays; the round-26/27 kill of the complement re-pose route (the enumerated classes survive adversarial re-pose attempts).
